alt: David Thompson's synthetic patient intake PDF goes into ExtractPatientInfo, a type-safe BAML function defined in baml_src/patient.baml and compiled by baml generate; one await b.ExtractPatientInfo(pdf) call on Gemini returns a typed Patient, written as output_patients/Patient_Intake_Form_David_Artificial.json with his name, date of birth, address, emergency contact, reason for visit and medications; editing that form rewrites only its JSON.

run.note: Compile baml_src/ into the baml_client package
Extract one JSON record per form
